ios.desc:
OnlyRun helps you show up for the runs you intend to do—with a private GPS log, scheduled Sessions, and live encouragement when you want it.

Start a run in seconds and keep a clean private history. Join free creator and community Sessions with their own schedule, progress, reminders, and live Run Rooms. When sharing helps, publish a live GPS link so friends can follow and signed-in supporters can cheer while you stay in control.

OnlyRun is built for runners who want accountability and real-time support without a noisy fitness feed or a data-selling business model.

- Fast GPS run recording
- Distance, pace, time, and route history
- Personal Log and calendar progress
- Free scheduled Sessions with clear goals and dates
- Live Run Rooms with a roster, cheers, and moderated messages
- Private Session progress and completion recognition
- Public race and run-club discovery
- Safe live GPS links for selected runs
- Signed-in cheers and encouragement messages
- Optional read-aloud support while you run
- Race check-in and event-ready broadcasts
- Privacy controls, reporting, blocking, and account deletion

Use OnlyRun for daily runs, consistency challenges, creator-led Sessions, group runs, race prep, public race days, and any run where a little encouragement helps you get out the door and keep going.

OnlyRun Plus unlocks optional premium features for runners who want more from live sharing, race broadcasts, saved-run tools, exports, and verified race badges. Core run recording, logs, public discovery, and eligible text support remain available without Plus.

quotes.text:
This is the first time I experienced iPhone app development. I've never really had the confidence to finish one.

The last mile ended up being very difficult and I've tested it on a marathon, bird pooing on me, many many field tests outside.

My main motivation was showing where I was during the marathon and talk to my family and friends then it evolved from there.

There's also an event planned for tomorrow at 4pm PST if you want to test out the multiplayer run feature, just go at your own pace, talk with short voice clips, send cheers.
